runs.text: How to Cook Eggs with Tomatoes and Cheese for Breakfast. Tomatoes. Onion.Eggs.

Yummy FOR BREAKFAST in minutes! Do you have a tomato and an egg? Inexpensive and tasty recipe. I have never tried such delicious eggs with Tomatoes ! I cook this simple recipe with eggs and  tomatoes all the time, especially in the summer. A quick and tasty dish with eggs and tomatoes is rich in vitamins and is perfect for breakfast, lunch or dinner. Add eggs to tomatoes and you will be surprised at the results. It's delicious, quick and easy, a recipe for every day. Prepare a wonderful dish with tomatoes and eggs and write to me how you liked my recipe.Be sure to try it! Don't forget to support the video with a like and leave a comment (even just an emoticon).
Subscribe to the channel: / @simpledeliciousresipes

INGREDIENTS:

1 red onion
1 tomato
5 eggs
1/2 sweet pepper
30 g parsley
Provençal herbs
Salt
Black olives 
50 g cheddar cheese

Bon appetit!
